children: Jingbo Technology, Inc. reported third-quarter results for the period ended Aug. 31, 2026, with revenue of $256238 and a net loss attributable to owners of $(507,431). Diluted EPS was $(0.001), reflecting continued pressure from lower parking-fee revenue after the termination of a major project.
Revenue: $256,238 for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, down from $381,683 in the year‑ago quarter ( (32.9%) ).
Net income: Net loss attributable to owners of the Company of $(507,431) for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, versus $(778,159) in the year‑ago quarter (improved YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.001) for the three months ended Aug 31, 2026, compared with $(0.001) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue Trend: Parking-fee revenue declined year over year for both the three- and six-month periods following the termination of a major Lishui hospital project.
Channel & Product Mix: The company’s revenue concentration shifted away from winery sales (now nil) toward its core smart-parking services and platform offerings.
Operational Scale-up: Management has expanded the corporate structure with multiple PRC and Hong Kong subsidiaries and VIEs to support smart-parking projects and mobile apps.
Cost & Margin Dynamics: Gross profit was sustained despite lower revenue due to reduced project-related costs and lower depreciation and salary expenses.
Strategic Focus & Outlook: Management is prioritizing growth in the smart-parking business, tighter cost control, continued R&D investment and pursuing equity or debt financing to support operations.
